设置参数`defaultExpandAll=True`后，初始化时将展开全部节点.en-us: Set `defaultExpandAll=True` to expand all nodes initially.

设置参数`showLine=False`后，将隐藏树内部的连接线。.en-us: Set `showLine=False` to hide tree connecting lines.

设置参数`showIcon=True`后，将显示各节点所定义的前缀图标。.en-us: Set `showIcon=True` to show the prefix icons defined for nodes.

通过参数`switcherIcon`可以传入**AntdIcon**中的`'an.en-us: Use `switcherIcon` with an **AntdIcon** `'antd-*'` icon component to control node expansion and collapse.

精确控制每个节点的样式。.en-us: Precisely control styles for individual nodes.

各节点可自由添加随鼠标移入触发的信息提示内容。.en-us: Add a hover tooltip to any node.

各节点可自由添加随鼠标右键触发的下拉菜单。.en-us: Add a context menu to any node.

设置参数`height`后将开启固定像素高度下的虚拟滚动功能，适用于数据量较大的.en-us: Set `height` to enable virtual scrolling within a fixed pixel height, suitable for large datasets.

设置参数`checkable=True`后可为多选模式额外添加节点勾选框。.en-us: Set `checkable=True` to add node checkboxes in multiple selection mode.

控制节点在不同勾选状态下的额外样式。.en-us: Customize node styles for checked and unchecked states.

控制节点在不同勾选状态下的额外后缀内容。.en-us: Customize node suffix content for checked and unchecked states.

设置参数`checkStrictly=True`后，父子节点间的勾选行为将彼此独.en-us: Set `checkStrictly=True` to make parent and child checking independent.

设置参数`treeDataMode='flat'`后，树结构应当传入扁平形式数据.en-us: Set `treeDataMode='flat'` to provide the tree as flat data.

在参数`treeDataMode='tree'`的前提下，通过设置参数`drag.en-us: Set `draggable=True` with `treeDataMode='tree'` to enable tree node dragging.

限制仅允许同级拖拽.en-us: Restrict dragging to the same level

设置参数`dragInSameLevel=True`后，节点拖拽行为只允许在同一.en-us: Set `dragInSameLevel=True` to restrict node dragging to the same level.

通过回调函数监听常见的交互事件。.en-us: Monitor common interaction events through callbacks.

通过回调函数监听节点拖拽事件。.en-us: Monitor node drag events through callbacks.

通过回调函数监听节点右键菜单点击事件。.en-us: Monitor node context menu clicks through callbacks.

基于参数`searchKeyword`快捷构建树搜索功能。.en-us: Use `searchKeyword` to add quick tree search.

快捷构建具有节点收藏功能的树形控件。.en-us: Build a tree with node favorites.

基于参数`scrollTarget`针对已展开的节点进行节点滚动动作。.en-us: Use `scrollTarget` to scroll to an expanded node.

设置参数`enableAsyncLoad=True`后，对于未设置`isLeaf.en-us: Set `enableAsyncLoad=True` to monitor expansion of nodes that have no `children` and do not set `isLeaf` to `True`, then update the tree asynchronously through callbacks.
